hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && f=$(bun -e 'const i = await Bun.stdin.json(); console.log(i.tool_input?.file_path ?? "")') && [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs ] && [ -f .prettierignore ] && bun node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write --ignore-unknown --log-level silent "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
